subject: Food Science
title: Psychrophiles: Cold-Loving Microbes
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Psychrophiles: Cold-Loving Microbes.

hook.text: Your fridge slows most bacteria. But psychrophiles thrive in the cold—they're the reason leftovers still spoil.

buildup.text: Psychrophiles grow between -5°C and 20°C. Your refrigerator at 4°C is their comfortable living room.

discovery.text: Listeria monocytogenes grows at refrigerator temperatures. It's why deli meats and soft cheeses carry warnings.

twist.text: Freezing at -18°C stops psychrophile growth but doesn't kill them. Thaw the food and they wake right up.

climax.text: Long-term cold storage selects for psychrophiles. Month-old leftovers may look fine but harbor millions.

punchline.text: Cold slows most germs. Psychrophiles laugh at your fridge.

quiz.question: What are psychrophiles?
options: Cold-loving microbes that grow at refrigerator temperatures
